ASOS station KBIS Bismarck Airport.
Picture from social media of tree branches down. Estimated around 3 in diameter. Time matched with the highest wind gust at KBIS ASOS 3 miles southeast of location.

Reports a lot of mostly small hail accumulating on the ground. The largest up to nickel size. Hail lasted about 20 minutes beginning around 8 pm central time. No damage reported.
